messages:
Diego Ramos: Heads up — SI co-sell sync: we need a quick alignment on lead routing rules before the marketplace push.
Anika Patel: On it. Quick Q: what's the expected cadence for pipeline sweeps? Weekly or more often around launch?
Trevor Li: Weekly cadence for steady state + daily triage the week of any joint announcement. For the Q2 marketplace push we should do daily the week before and the week after.
Emily K: For account mapping: propose definition for 'owned' vs 'shared' — suggest threshold `ARR >= $100k` => owned by SI unless customer explicitly opts out. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Diego Ramos: I like the threshold. Also propose a tagging convention in SFDC: `si:partner_acct_id` and `routing:territory`. Keeps routing deterministic.
PartnerBot: New partner intake created: AtlasOne (partner_id: A-778). Intake owner: Anika Patel. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/partners/778
Anika Patel: If SI submits a lead they get a 72h claim window before it becomes shared pool. Can we shorten to 48h for SP1/high-priority accounts?
Trevor Li: 48h works for SP1. We should define SP1 (strategic) criteria in the playbook. Also need demo handoff SLA: partner must deliver intro/demo within 5 business days or we step in.
Emily K: Adding joint announcement checklist items: partner legal LOA, co-branded assets, pre-announce Q/A, and a 'hardware partner compatibility' column for Dedicated/private deployments.
Diego Ramos: Decision recap: 48h claim window for SP1, 72h for SP2. Action items: Anika to update playbook; Trevor to push SFDC tag taxonomy; Emily to add the HW compatibility column to the joint-announcement tracker.
Anika Patel: Got it. Will update the playbook and post changes. ETA EOD Wed. @Trevor Li ping me when you update tags so I can QA.
Trevor Li: Will update tags today and drop a tiny script for bulk tagging in #eng-platform. Example snippet below if anyone wants to test:
```
# pseudo-SFDC bulk tag
curl -X POST https://sfdc.api/redwood/tags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"id":"A-778","tags":["si:A-778","routing:na-west"]}'
```
Diego Ramos: Thanks — I'll schedule a 30m post-launch triage for day+3 and invite the SRE and product folks.
Emily K: :thumbsup: Also starting a short eval to capture latency/cost delta for our HW partners (NVIDIA + QLogic) on Dedicated. I'll share a first-pass spreadsheet by Monday.
PartnerBot: Reminder: joint-announcement checklist updated by Emily K. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/joint-announce-checklist
